about: Held-out cases for phase 0 (scripts/score_phase0.py; design_process.md, point 86). Written from the rules' text only, not from MTAC's checker code; no agent sees them. The clean project follows all 8 rules: each code file starts with the coding line, then the AI-Assisted line, and no function is longer than 60 lines; the clean reply starts with 喵～, calls itself 代码小灵, calls the user 开发者大大, is Chinese only and ends with 哒～. Each case below breaks exactly one rule (rule null: a case that must pass; 我们 is out of R2's scope, as the user reads it). Added 2026-10-21: a clean index.html in the clean project (both header lines as HTML comments), and three HTML cases (R5, R6, R7: a 68-line function in a <script>), since MTAC's checker counts HTML as code.
